purpose: Define common governance expectations shared across the repository family while preserving lane-specific differences.
principles: generated artifacts are reproducible outputs, not unmanaged truth
automation prepares and verifies; human gates decide high-impact promotion
public repositories must not expose or mutate private/core projects
process artifacts must not become hidden authority
retained artifacts require ongoing quality, health, security, and compliance posture
maintained lanes need durable state, continuity anchors, and recovery paths
important decisions should be observable and explainable through public-safe evidence
intent and capability routing are portable collaboration invariants, not one agent implementation
public_repository_expectations: ongoing quality, health, security, and compliance posture
private_repository_expectations: public projection or template path is explicit when applicable
secrets and local state stay private
verification exists for the private workflow
no blind bidirectional sync with public repositories
backup, restore, and rollback are explicit when runtime state is managed
shared_checks: language switch is present where bilingual docs exist
role and does-not-own scope are stated
candidate and approved states are not confused
private project names and internals are not exposed
generated artifacts are not treated as hand-edited truth
stale drafts and temporary reports are not treated as authority
retained artifacts have lifecycle assurance posture
important automation and promotion decisions are explainable
support or funding does not bypass review
runtime adapters preserve intent-contract invariants before claiming portability
